description: This file defines a Java class 'KafkaManagerCondition' that extends 'AllNestedConditions' from Spring Boot. It is used to conditionally enable certain configurations based on specific properties related to Fineract batch manager and Kafka message handler. The class contains nested static classes with conditional annotations that check for properties 'fineract.mode.batch-manager-enabled' and 'fineract.remote-job-message-handler.kafka.enabled'.

classes.name: KafkaManagerCondition
classes.description: A conditional configuration class that activates based on nested property conditions, used within Spring Boot configurations.
